# Trimble Maps Multi-Vehicle Routing API (Appian)

- **Product:** Trimble Maps Multi-Vehicle Routing API (Appian) (Trimble Maps family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** API key (ApiKeyAuth); Appian bearer tokens from the Appian Identity API. Declared security schemes: ApiKeyAuth.
- **Access:** Trimble Maps Appian customers.
- **To call it you would need:** Appian API credentials for services.appian.trimblemaps.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://services.appian.trimblemaps.com`.
- **Definition:** [trimble-maps/multi-vehicle](https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/api/multi-vehicle.json) (Multi-Vehicle Routing API, version 1.0). Documentation: https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/multi-vehicle-routing/api, https://developer.trimblemaps.com/restful-apis/multi-vehicle-routing/api/.
